We’re looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join us on our journey to become one stronger, more integrated SaaS business. You’ll work across commercial contracts, privacy and cybersecurity in the European and North American market, partnering with colleagues across the organisation to find practical solutions and support our growth.

Reporting to our General Counsel, you’ll work at the intersection of commercial law, privacy, cybersecurity and business transformation. You’ll play a key role in enabling business growth, supporting complex customer deals, and ensuring that our legal commitments are practical, proportionate and aligned with how we operate.

Whether you’re building on your experience in private practice or looking to grow further in an in-house role, this is an opportunity for you to take ownership, learn along the way, and make a real difference.

We are open to on-site (offices in Copenhagen and Wrocław), hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET), plus the US East Coast.

**About Us

**Cookie Information, Piwik PRO, and Sheltr, are leading SaaS brands specialising in privacy-first compliance and analytics. Together, we’re building intuitive, user-friendly products that help organisations navigate data privacy and marketing insights. With headquarters in Copenhagen and an office in Wrocław, our teams have been working across various industries to build trusted data privacy solutions since 2011.

We’re bringing our brands closer together to build one company with a shared identity in the group, a clear focus and ambitious plan for the future. The Legal, Compliance and Cybersecurity team has a core role to play in making that happen.

The role

These will be your main tasks:

Handle commercial contracts, particularly sales contracts

• Draft, review and negotiate customer contracts for EU and US customers.

• Support partner, reseller and supplier agreements, as well as more specialised regulatory requirements such as DORA-related terms and US healthcare BAAs.

• Work closely with Sales and Account Management to find solutions that support our commercial goals while managing legal risks.

Privacy compliance and cybersecurity

• Support GDPR compliance, international data transfers, sub-processor management and relevant UK and US privacy requirements.

• Work with our Cybersecurity team on NIS2 compliance and related contractual requirements.

• Help our Cyber Security and Compliance teams to respond to customer privacy and security questionnaires, audits and due diligence requests.

• Advise Product teams on privacy, consent and data protection, helping ensure that our commitments reflect how we actually work.

Help shape the way we work

• Improve legal templates, processes and ways of working as the business grows.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Sales, Product, Security, Finance and Operations.

• Contribute to shaping our legal function and how we support the wider business.

**About You

**You’re a structured, independent, and commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working with people and finding practical solutions. You combine sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a business operates. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, thinking creatively and making decisions, even when the answer isn’t entirely straightforward.

You know that good legal advice is not just about identifying risks; it’s about helping the business understand those risks and finding a way forward.

You bring:

• 2-5 years of experience with commercial contracts, gained in-house or at a law firm.

• An understanding of B2B contracting and an interest in SaaS or technology businesses.

• Working knowledge of GDPR and privacy law in a commercial context, or relevant experience with HIPAA and US privacy law.

• The ability to communicate clearly, and comfortable working directly with Sales on live deals and making pragmatic judgement calls.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with cybersecurity regulations (NIS2 and/or DORA).

• Experience with HIPAA, including negotiating BAAs.

• Knowledge of corporate governance, employment/HR legal matters (DK, PL, DE, and/or US).

• Experience with US customers and US commercial contracting, including state privacy laws and/or wiretap/tracking litigation risk.

• Experience building processes and templates in a growing legal function.

What we offer

• The opportunity to make a real impact. You’ll help shape a growing international SaaS business as it evolves towards a more integrated, enterprise-ready organisation. You won’t simply be maintaining existing processes; you’ll help develop the legal and commercial foundations for our next stage of growth.

• International exposure and commercial ownership. You’ll work on customer and partner relationships across the US and Europe, gaining exposure to complex commercial negotiations and a broad range of legal and regulatory challenges.

• The chance to broaden your expertise, take ownership of meaningful projects and grow with the business.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the General Counsel and a stakeholder from the company (online)

• A final interview with our General Counsel including a live case (online or in-person, TBD)

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

With an IoT platform connecting more than 6 million units — and growing — Trackunit is building the platform that will enable the construction industry to work faster, smarter, and more securely. And we need you to help run and scale it.

As an SRE, you will join our Europe-based team and be part of a global SRE organization spanning Europe and Canada. This is a hands-on role focused on the daily operation and continuous improvement of our platform, with room to grow into larger design and architecture work as you build depth.

The platform owned by SRE consists of an AWS cloud, Kubernetes clusters (EKS), and our IaC setup running Terraform and Terramate, as well as a GitOps delivery platform built on Argo CD and Atlantis.

We support engineering teams with 150+ developers. You will help keep a platform used by 15,000+ active users every day secure, available, and easy to build on.

We're looking for someone curious and collaborative — happy to share knowledge and ask questions as well.

Experience level: roughly 2–5 years in an SRE, DevOps, platform, or infrastructure operations role. If you're further along and the day-to-day scope appeals to you, apply anyway — we'll have the conversation.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

**What's in it for you?

**

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

**What You'll Do

**Your week will be a mix of keeping things running well and making them better.

• Operate and improve the platform. Monitoring, alerting, capacity, cost, and the steady stream of small improvements that keep a large AWS and Kubernetes estate healthy.

• Work in code, not consoles. Infrastructure changes go through Terraform and Helm, reviewed as pull requests and delivered through Atlantis and Argo CD.

• Keep the platform secure. Patching, vulnerability remediation, base image updates, and closing findings — a recurring, meaningful part of the job rather than a side task.

• Take part in incident response. You'll join our on-call rotation (SRE team, business hours) and contribute to incidents and follow-up work.

• Handle triage and requests from developer teams. Understanding what they need, unblocking them, and spotting when a repeated request could be automated.

**Who You Are

**We think you'll need

• Hands-on experience running workloads on AWS.

• Basic knowledge with Kubernetes.

• Basic knowledge about infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform.

• Comfortable with Git, Linux and Windows.

• Clear written communication — a lot of our work happens in tickets, PRs, and docs.

**Nice to have, not expected

**

• EKS specifically, or tooling like Karpenter, Argo CD, Atlantis, or Terramate.

• Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Sumo Logic, or similar).

• Scripting in Python or Go.

• Security or compliance work — vulnerability management, CIS benchmarks, certification programmes.

• Multi-region or multi-account AWS architecture.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You’re curious and self-driven, while also knowing when to ask for help when needed.

• You finish things. Small, well-tested changes shipped consistently beat big ideas that stall.

• You care about the developers and customers using the platform, not just the platform itself.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement. An interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work — including MCP servers and agents against our own platform — and we expect that to grow. We don’t expect you to have experience with this—but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries — this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

**How You'll Grow Here

**We hire at this level expecting you to move beyond it, and we've structured the team so that happens on purpose rather than by accident.

• A rotation model that protects your focus. The team splits between operational duty and project work, so you're not permanently interrupt-driven. You get real blocks of time to go deep on something.

• Mentorship that's built in. Senior colleagues review your PRs and pair with you on incidents. Asking questions is the expected behaviour, not a sign you're struggling.

• Exposure to the big architecture work. You'll start with scoped pieces and take on more as you build context.

• A clear conversation about your development. Regular 1:1s that cover where you want to be, not just what you shipped last sprint.

**What We're Building Next

**Trackunit is moving from a SaaS company to a platform built on telemetry data from the construction industry worldwide. For SRE, that means going beyond delivering infrastructure to building the capabilities that let our developers and customers spin up environments tailored to their needs in the regions they need them.

Things on our roadmap include:

• Expanding the platform into a true multi-region architecture.

• Building self-service platform capabilities so developer teams move at their own pace.

• Making better use of AI in our own operations, through MCP servers and agents.

You won't be expected to lead these on day one. You will be in the room, and there will be pieces with your name on them.

**What Happens From Here — Recruitment Process Overview

**

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with a member of our Talent Partner team

• Personality-based interview. You will be asked to complete an online personality assessment prior to the interview. There are no correct answers and we are not trying to categorise you — the aim is a dialogue about the results and Trackunit's culture, so you get to know us better as well.

• Assignment-specific interview. You will be given a case to prepare after the initial screening interview. You will present the case to relevant colleagues across Trackunit, who you will also work closely with in the role.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with Engineering Manager, Kåre Brandborg and an SRE team member.

• References and background checks (if needed). If required, we will obtain references from former employers and perform level-specific background checks, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're lucky to have you!

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction — one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

jobs.description:
If you’re energised by driving lean transformation at a company level and you thrive on turning complex challenges into tangible business impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Lean Consultant to join our team of highly skilled colleagues in the Project Excellence department. In Project Excellence, we act as internal consultants grounded in Lean, supporting projects and leadership across NNE by strengthening performance management, structured problem solving and continuous improvement practices.

As a Senior Lean Consultant, you will work closely with project organisations and leaders to set direction for improvement initiatives, build Lean capabilities and drive performance. At the same time, you will take an active, hands-on role in facilitating problem solving and implementing improvements on our most critical projects, ensuring that ideas translate into real impact.

This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of leadership, Lean transformation and project execution, contributing to building a strong and sustainable performance and improvement culture across NNE.

You’ll be based in our Virum Office, but the role requires you to visit our project sites in Kalundborg and around the Copenhagen area on a regular basis.

How you might spend your days

As a Senior Lean Consultant, you’ll be:

• Helping the Project Excellence department set direction for continuous improvement and Lean in NNE, aligned with NNE’s strategy

• Building Lean capabilities by developing and embedding structured problem solving, lean project management and continuous improvement practices

• Designing and delivering training in Lean tools, Lean principles and Lean ways of working across NNE

• Coaching leaders and teams to strengthen performance management and Lean leadership behaviours

• Facilitating and driving structured problem-solving on major projects, using A3 thinking as our core approach

• Advising on consistent implementation of improvements, ensuring solutions are anchored and deliver real impact

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Passionate about Lean thinking and driven to create real lasting business impact

• Confident in engaging, challenging and developing leaders and teams at all levels

• Comfortable operating in complex environments, bringing clarity, structure and direction

• Pragmatic and execution-focused with a great drive to turn ideas into results

• A credible role model who takes ownership and leads by example

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Extensive experience driving continuous improvement and lean transformations in complex organisations

• Proven ability to lead and implement change with measurable impact

• Solid experience working closely with senior leaders on performance and improvement agendas

• A relevant academic degree at Master level

• Excellent facilitation, coaching and stakeholder management skills across organisational levels

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please Contact Director Daniel Iwarsson at +45 3075 7823 or Principal Consultant, Mikkel Bonne at +45 3191 8723 between 12.00-15.00 (12 AM-3 PM) on weekdays.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Build the mobile app that construction professionals rely on every day.

**Every day, tens of thousands of construction professionals around the world use the Dalux app to inspect buildings, document progress, navigate BIM models, capture photos, report issues and collaborate directly from active construction sites.

We're looking for Mobile Software Engineers who want to build software that solves real-world problems at scale.

**What You'll Be Building

**You'll join one of our cross-functional product teams responsible for developing and improving the Dalux mobile application.

Together with developers, product managers and designers, you'll help shape new features from the product discussion through implementation, testing and release.

Our app is built using C# and .NET MAUI , allowing us to share the majority of our codebase while integrating with native iOS and Android capabilities whenever it makes sense.

**Some of the challenges you'll work on

**Mobile development at Dalux goes far beyond forms and lists. You'll help solve challenges such as:

• Building reliable workflows for construction sites with limited connectivity

• Integrating with mobile hardware such as 360 cameras and GPS antennas

• Optimizing performance across both Android and iOS devices

• Designing intuitive user experiences for professionals working in demanding environments

• Continuously improving the speed, quality and usability of one of the industry's leading mobile applications

**Our engineering culture

**You'll become part of a product team where engineers have real ownership.

We believe the people building the software should influence how it's built. That means short decision paths, close collaboration with product and design, and plenty of room to propose new ideas.

Our development teams work using agile principles with a strong focus on quality, collaboration and continuous improvement.

**We'd love to hear from you if you

**

• Have a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a similar technical field

• Enjoy solving complex engineering problems

• Care about building products that people genuinely enjoy using

• Like collaborating with other developers, designers and product managers

Experience with one or more of the following is a plus:

• C#

• .NET MAUI

• Kotlin

• Swift

• Flutter

• React Native

If you don't have professional mobile experience yet but are passionate about mobile development and have a strong software engineering foundation, we'd still encourage you to apply.

**Why Dalux?

**At Dalux, you'll build software that makes one of the world's largest industries more digital, efficient and sustainable.

Our products are used in more than 140 countries, and mobile is central to that experience.

All software development happens from our headquarters in Copenhagen, where you'll work alongside a growing community of software engineers in an environment that values knowledge sharing, technical discussions and continuous learning. We also have monthly social events and various clubs for those who want to take part.

You'll find a flat organization with a high degree of trust, opportunities to influence the product, and colleagues who care deeply about building great software.

**Ready to join us?

**If you'd like to help build the mobile platform used by tens of thousands of construction professionals every day, we'd love to hear from you.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005. We develop digital tools that help make the construction industry smarter and more efficient through intuitive software and Building Information Modelling (BIM). Today, our solutions are used on construction projects in more than 140 countries worldwide.

**Sign-up for our free Pizza & Beer event the 29th of October 2026 at Dalux from 16:00: Pizza and Beer with Dalux

During the event, you can hear more about Dalux and the career options through presentations and mingling - all while getting delicious Pizza and beer/drinks!

All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail. 🥞

We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk. 🚀

**🤩 About The Role

**We are looking for Senior Account Executive who loves the chase, the close and the craft. You’ll own a territory and build your own pipeline of high-value targets, and booming inbound channel feeding you qualified opportunities. You call the shots on where to hunt, who to warm, and how to win. We’ll back you with marketing air cover, product firepower, and leadership you can trust for support and development.

**🎯 What You Will Do

**

• Create and run your target list of dream logos in our ICP. Name them, map them, multi-thread them.

• Work a blended pipe: your self-sourced opportunities plus SDR-sourced meetings you turn into revenue.

• Full cycle everything: discovery → tailored demo → value proof → commercial design → close → high-five.

• Build business cases that make budget holders nod and sign (ROI, payback, the whole nine yards).

• Feedback like a pro: turn deal learnings into sharper messaging, better product bets, and smoother process.

• Beat targets without burning out.

🙌 **You’ll thrive here if you…

**

• You speak excellent English and are based in Copenhagen.

• 5+ years of SaaS sales under your belt, fluent in consultative selling, and MEDPICC. Psst... If you’ve sold into hospitality, we’re listening even harder.

• You’re curious, ambitious, disciplined, and self-driven.

• Are owner-minded. You don’t wait for leads, you create momentum and you love a clean CRM.

• Can navigate complex cycles and senior stakeholders, you’re credible in the boardroom and fun.

• Are data-curious and coachable. You test, learn, and iterate faster than most people.

**💎 Why All Gravy

**

• Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

• A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.

• Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

• The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. We work hard and celebrate harder.

Ready to roll? Curious, competitive, kind? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. Attitude and growth mindset matter. Let’s build the future of frontline work together.

Your role

Bring your curiosity to work as our next Rental Desk Coordinator at our depot in Albertslund, outside of Copenhagen. You will be part of our Danish Rental Desk Team team reporting to our Operations and Service Lead. In this role, your mission is to deliver an outstanding customer experience, ensure operational excellence, and support profitable and sustainable rental activities. You will contribute directly to how we create high‑quality products and solutions for our customers.

Your day-to-day

• Handle customer inquiries, coordinate quotations, ensure optimal fleet planning, process work orders, and ensure accurate and timely invoicing

• Coordinate the tracking and transportation of rental equipment between customers and depots, ensuring timely availability and returns

• Handle rental contract administration including amendments and renewals with meticulous attention to detail

• Support the implementation of company processes, KPIs, and service standards, ensuring transparency, compliance, and continuous improvement across all rental activities

• Collaborate with the sales team to manage credit collection processes, ensuring financial accuracy and compliance

• Provide customers with accurate and timely documentation and information, supporting their rental experience effectively

• Support operations and rental team within Denmark and Norway

• You work closely with colleagues from Sales, Service, Logistics, Marketing, Accounting, and other Rental Desks, both locally and abroad.

Your skills and experience

• A secondary education diploma or equivalent professional experience

• Proficient communication skills in both Danish, English, and Norwegian, enabling clear and professional interactions across diverse stakeholders is a must

• Proactive approach to customer support, which enhances customer satisfaction and strengthen partnerships

• A problem-solving mindset and driven personality, through which you do everything you can to strive for continuous improvement and happy customers

• Strong understanding of business processes, administrative workflows, and safety procedures

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks and manage time efficiently to meet operational targets and customer needs

• Proficiency with MS Office tools and experience with systems such as ERP, Salesforce, and Medius and a willingness to learn and adapt to new systems, ensuring smooth integration with internal processes

• A team player with strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, contributing constructively while respecting diverse perspectives

• Basic knowledge or interest in logistics and understanding of equipment movement and planning is an advantage but not a must

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

Your compensation and benefits

At Atlas Copco Group, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation. Compensation is determined based on the position and its responsibilities, without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our compensation offering is designed to be locally relevant, competitive, and aligned with the expectations of current and future talent.

Beyond compensation, we believe that a rewarding career is about having opportunities to learn, grow, contribute, and develop in an environment built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. At Atlas Copco Group, we support our people in building long-term careers while making a meaningful impact through their work.

Your job location

This role requires you to work on-site at our depot located in Albertslund, where the offices are also located . You will be part of a dynamic team and enjoy the benefits of face-to-face collaboration. Some travel for training purposes will be required, mainly to Belgium where our head office is located.

Why it is great to work with us

Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you.

Application process

Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us. If you have questions during the process or need support, please contact Operations and Service Lead, Pia Jonassen at Pia Jonassen pia.jonassen@atlascopco.com.

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we are uniting curious minds, and you could be one of them.

Information at a Glance

Atlas Copco delivers innovative products and solutions that help businesses grow and drive progress. Our portfolio spans compressed air and gas systems and treatment, vacuum solutions, industrial power tools, assembly systems, and power and flow solutions. We bring a commitment to long-term success built on expertise, reliable service, and uptime. When you level up to the Atlas Copco experience you enter a partnership based on quality, sustainability, and ease of collaboration. The technology we bring, and the decades of experience support the future-proofing of your business. Atlas Copco is a brand within Atlas Copco Group.

Would you like to lead the Danish FP&A function in an international manufacturing company and help create greater financial transparency, stronger decision support and closer partnerships with operations and sales?

JELD-WEN is looking for a business-oriented Head of FP&A who can combine financial discipline with operational and commercial understanding. You will take a key role in the Danish organisation, where you will be responsible for strengthening the quality and credibility of financial information while developing FP&A into an increasingly proactive business partner.

Key finance role in an international manufacturing organisation

As Head of FP&A – Denmark, you will be a member of the Danish country leadership team and report to the Head of FP&A – Northern Europe. You will lead a team of two FP&A Analysts and work closely with leaders across operations, manufacturing and sales, as well as finance colleagues throughout Northern Europe and relevant stakeholders at headquarters.

Your initial focus will be to establish confidence in the Danish financial figures and ensure that reporting, forecasts and budgets are accurate, transparent and clearly explained. On this foundation, you will strengthen forward-looking analysis and decision support and bring the FP&A function closer to the commercial and operational organisation.

The position covers JELD-WEN’s two Danish manufacturing sites in Herning and Sønder Felding and requires regular presence at both locations. Working within an international matrix organisation, you will have a broad interface across functions, countries and organisational levels.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading monthly performance reporting, forecasting and budgeting for the Danish organisation

• Maintaining oversight of the Danish P&L, balance sheet and cash flow

• Ensuring the quality, transparency and credibility of financial information

• Explaining financial developments and the underlying operational and commercial drivers

• Ensuring compliance with relevant financial requirements, including US GAAP and local GAAP

• Acting as a financial business partner to leaders in operations, manufacturing, sales and the Danish country leadership team

• Translating financial and operational data into clear insights and recommendations

• Leading, developing and supporting two FP&A Analysts

• Improving and simplifying recurring reporting and FP&A processes

• Identifying opportunities to automate reporting and strengthen dashboard capabilities

• Contributing to the development of systems, data and FP&A practices across Northern Europe

Strong FP&A profile with business understanding

The ideal candidate brings a strong background within FP&A, business controlling or commercial finance, combined with broad experience in financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, performance management and business partnering. The position can be relevant both for an experienced finance leader and for a senior finance profile ready to take on broader responsibility for the FP&A agenda and leadership of a small team.

A good understanding of the operational and commercial drivers behind financial performance is important, together with the ability to take ownership of financial reporting, analysis and planning. Equally important is the ability to translate financial and operational data into clear insights and recommendations and to work closely with stakeholders across the business.

Experience from a manufacturing or operational environment is preferred, particularly where finance acts as a close business partner to operations and commercial functions. Experience from an international or matrix organisation will be an advantage.

You have strong analytical capabilities and are comfortable working with large datasets, financial models and Excel. Experience with ERP systems, dashboards and financial reporting or consolidation tools such as SAP, OneStream, HFM or Hyperion will be an advantage.

Previous people management experience is an advantage, but not necessarily a prerequisite. Leadership experience may also have been gained through project management, professional leadership or as a senior member of a finance team. Are you approaching the end of your studies and looking for a graduation project early 2027. Does deep dive into the protection of the primary equipment enabling transport of wind energy to shore excite you? Then we have the project for you.

The projects

Protection study

Today we apply state of the art, cutting edge protections of the primary equipment, 220/66kV transformers, shunt reactors, subsea cables etc. Functions like line differential protection, restricted earth fault protection, distance protection with fiber optic accelerations schemes and different mechanical protections.

But how well do the different protections cover the primary equipment?

Are all protections feasible, considering how often we statistically experience faults?

Grounding

Today the MV grid, connecting the wind turbines to the Offshore Sub Station is impedance grounded. This creates different problems and side effects that needs to be considered during engineering. Some primary equipment becomes expensive and hard to procure. Protection against earth faults becomes challenging because of the reduced fault current.

Would you like to set the technical direction for Denmark's national, digitally sovereign supercomputing and cloud platform? DTU Computerome is looking for a Chief Technology Officer to lead the architecture, engineering and long-term technology strategy of a platform used by researchers, public institutions and industry across Denmark. 

About DTU Computerome 
DTU Computerome is a national High-Performance Computing (HPC) and secure cloud platform designed to support sensitive data processing and the hosting of advanced applications and services. 

The platform is developed and operated as a fully digitally sovereign infrastructure. Critical research workloads, sensitive data, and digital services for the public sector and Danish industry are hosted within a trusted, nationally controlled environment. 

Computerome functions as a general infrastructure and service provider, offering: 

• High-performance computing resources for complex workloads 
• Secure environments for processing sensitive and regulated data 
• Infrastructure for hosting research platforms, digital services and scientific applications 
• Flexible environments for innovation, experimentation and development of new digital solutions 
Users include research groups from all Danish universities, international research collaborations, public authorities and industry partners. Many rely on Computerome as a stable platform for long-running services, data platforms and research applications. 

The infrastructure includes a large-scale Linux-based HPC cluster, a 50 PB high-performance storage system, a custom-built secure cloud environment, and platforms for containerized applications, research services and data workflows. Computerome is physically located at DTU Risø, while the operations and development team is based at DTU Lyngby. 

The Job 
As CTO, you will own Computerome's technology strategy and platform architecture, and lead the engineering and DevOps organisation that operates and develops it. You will be part of Computerome's management team and work closely with the Director and COO on strategy, investments and partnerships. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• Defining and owning the technology strategy and multi-year roadmap for the HPC, storage, network and cloud platform 
• Leading, developing and recruiting the DevOps and platform engineering teams, including the five new DevOps engineers currently being hired 
• Owning the overall platform architecture and making key design decisions across compute, storage, networking and cloud 
• Ensuring stable, secure and scalable operation, including incident management, on-call structure and service levels 
• Driving automation, Infrastructure-as-Code and modern DevOps practices across the organisation 
• Leading technical evaluation, requirement specification and vendor selection in procurements and tenders 
• Planning capacity, lifecycle and hardware refresh, and owning the technical side of investment cases and budgets 
• Representing Computerome technically towards users, partners, authorities and national and European infrastructure initiatives 
Strategic Focus Areas 
Computerome is growing from a research HPC facility into a broader national provider of sovereign compute, data and cloud services. As CTO you will shape how the platform meets that ambition. Key areas include: 

• Digital sovereignty: Designing an architecture built on open, European-controllable technologies that reduces dependence on non-European hyperscalers, and ensuring data portability and national control over critical workloads 
• AI and GPU infrastructure: Expanding capacity and services for AI, large-scale analytics and GPU-intensive research 
• Secure and regulated environments: Strengthening platforms for sensitive personal and health data, in line with GDPR, NIS2, ISO and relevant security standards 
• Cloud and platform services: Evolving the secure cloud, container and Kubernetes offerings so that public institutions and industry can host long-running services and products 
• Scalability and new capacity: Contributing technically to new datacenter capacity, energy efficiency and long-term infrastructure planning 
• Operational excellence: Building monitoring, observability, service management and processes that match the expectations of critical national infrastructure 
Your Profile 
We are looking for an experienced technology leader who combines deep infrastructure expertise with strategic overview and the ability to build strong teams. 

Required qualifications 

• A master's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience 
• At least 10 years of experience with large-scale IT infrastructure, of which several years in a technical leadership role 
• Proven experience leading engineering, DevOps or operations teams, including people management and recruitment 
• Deep knowledge of Linux-based infrastructure, virtualization and cloud platforms (e.g. OpenStack, Kubernetes) 
• Solid understanding of storage, networking and IT security architecture 
• Experience with automation, Infrastructure-as-Code and modern DevOps practices 
• Experience with technical procurement, vendor management and budget responsibility 
• Ability to translate technology into strategy and communicate clearly with management, users and partners 
• Fluency in English; Danish is an advantage 
It is an advantage if you also have experience with 

• HPC environments, job scheduling and parallel file systems (e.g. IBM Storage Scale) 
• AI workloads and GPU infrastructure at scale 
• Sensitive data environments and compliance (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001) 
• Public sector procurement, EU tenders or research infrastructure 
• European cloud and sovereignty initiatives 
• Datacenter design, power and cooling 
What We Offer 
We offer a key leadership role with real influence on how a national, digitally sovereign computing platform evolves. You will lead skilled colleagues in an international research environment where advanced infrastructure directly enables scientific discovery and digital innovation. 

At DTU we emphasize: 

• A high level of technical professionalism 
• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development 
• The possibility to shape national digital infrastructure 
• A collaborative environment with highly skilled colleagues 
Salary and Appointment Terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). You are employed as an Academic Officer, Senior Officer, Senior Executive Officer. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures 

The position is full-time and based at DTU Lyngby with regular presence at DTU Risø.

Application and Contact 
Please submit your online application no later than 13 November 2026. Open the "Apply now" link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Mads Bager Hoffmann on mabho@dtu.dk

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture.
